editorial.blurb: This hidden gem serves inventive, impeccably fresh sushi in an intimate, beautifully decorated space with warm, attentive service.
editorial.insiderTip: Catch their special deal for 2 classic rolls and 2 sashimi around $15–20, and don't sleep on their unique signature rolls like Monoke and Moving Castle—reviewers can't stop raving about them.
